findings.summary: g3_sf_evaluate_v1 builds a hard-coded ledger from computed values and ignores declared ledger entries; validation does not bind entry effect/sign to endpoint role/sign.
findings.required_repair: Bind evaluation/validation to declared ledger entries and add public contradictory-ledger controls.

findings.summary: The declaration hash is computed but g3_sf_validate_v1 does not recompute it; no tampered declaration-hash fail_closed test exists.
findings.required_repair: Recompute _g3sf_body hash during validation/admission and add a public tamper control.

findings.summary: actual authority only requires v5/ref/digest types and matching candidate_ref; contract hash content and same-candidate layer ref/hash are not verified.
findings.required_repair: Add exact same-candidate G1/G2 public ref/hash binding or keep actual status inadmissible, with foreign/stale controls.

findings.summary: program_exception exists in source but no independent public test reaches it; current negative test only reaches fail_closed.
findings.required_repair: Provide a documented fault seam or reachable malformed typed input and assert program_exception at row/admission level.

findings.summary: Equation and closure formulas are non-empty strings only and are never parsed or checked against rational evaluation.
findings.required_repair: Use typed/canonical formula semantics or reject text/numeric contradictions with a fail_closed control.

static_passes: exact rational 120 to 90 plus 15 plus 15 fixture arithmetic
efficiency edit changes declaration hash and field value in test surface
typed endpoint units directions signs and owner scope constructors
missing G1/G2 authority remains terminal_deferred in synthetic fixture
no obvious forward-definition or invalid return-ternary pattern
